title: Brandwatch Review (2026)
intro: Brandwatch is evaluated here as Marketing & Growth software — Brandwatch (Cision) provides enterprise consumer intelligence, social listening, social media management, and influencer marketing solutions. Pricing pages emphasize demos and solution packaging rather than public dollar floors (2026-08-17) — contact sales / schedule demo. Confirm live proposal scope. Do not invent custom-quote dollars. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s marketing methodology (ease of use, campaign/content tools, marketing automation, funnel/conversion, analytics, brand monitoring, integrations, scalability, value, AI). It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose Brandwatch when enterprise consumer intelligence / social listening is the primary job and custom packaging is acceptable.
verdict: Choose Brandwatch when enterprise consumer intelligence / social listening is the primary job and custom packaging is acceptable. Compare Meltwater for alternate enterprise intelligence, Brand24 for published SMB listening, and Hootsuite/Sprout when publishing/care is primary. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging on the vendor site before purchase.
